_README: Label id -> structure name for TotalSegmentator v2's 'craniofacial_structures' task, plus the reviewed mapping onto atlas entities.
A KEY, not data: it contains no anatomy and no geometry. Entries with atlas_id null are decisions NOT to map, each with its reason.
source: Wasserthal J et al., TotalSegmentator (Radiology: AI 2023, doi:10.1148/ryai.230024); class map transcribed from totalsegmentator/map_to_binary.py, v2.18.0, Apache-2.0. Task listed in the project README under 'Openly available for any usage (Apache-2.0 license)'.

skull.note: One mask over the whole skull minus the mandible. The atlas carries the individual cranial and facial bones, which CT at 1.5 mm cannot separate along their sutures; the composite entity 'cranium' receives it, the same way 'ribs_l' receives twelve rib masks.

teeth_lower.note: No dental entities in this atlas.

teeth_upper.note: No dental entities in this atlas.

head.note: Whole-head soft-tissue envelope, not an anatomical entity.
